verdict.rationale: Glama's pricing page mentions 'Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks' (glama-docs-10), suggesting some webhook-driven automation exists, but there is no documentation of subscribing an agent to events from downstream connected apps, no event/webhook API reference, and no example of triggers replacing polling. Missing for 10: documented webhook/event subscription API, examples of downstream app event triggers, confirmation this applies to agent-tool integrations rather than just internal automation.
